decisions.reason: Its continued presence through 2024 suggests the fifteen-day express program is performing at least satisfactorily relative to aspiration levels and it reinforces the firm's service-speed positioning with limited strategic distance from the core business.

The seventy-two-hour express program remained on the website in 2024, indicating results good enough to justify continuation, and a large firm with service and logistics capabilities has the slack to retain this premium fast-delivery offer.

Because the express delivery program for doors and gates kept its own page across both years, management would read it as meeting or exceeding aspirations and as a strong fit with the firm's established customization and rapid-response model.

The online ordering and digital services platform still had a dedicated page in 2024 and supports the firm's strategic move toward deeper advisory and service integration, so boundedly rational management would continue it rather than redeploy those complementary resources.

The fire and smoke protection door gained prominence from a website mention in 2023 to its own page in 2024, a clear sign of performance above aspiration or rising strategic importance, so it should be retained.
